ccb_date_order.name: ccb_date_order
ccb_date_order.value: "credit_card_bills"."closing_date" IS NULL OR "credit_card_bills"."due_date" IS NULL OR "credit_card_bills"."due_date" >= "credit_card_bills"."closing_date"

ccb_closing_period.name: ccb_closing_period
ccb_closing_period.value: "credit_card_bills"."closing_date" IS NULL OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "credit_card_bills"."closing_date") = "credit_card_bills"."month" AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "credit_card_bills"."closing_date") = "credit_card_bills"."year")

ccb_paid_consistency.name: ccb_paid_consistency
ccb_paid_consistency.value: ("credit_card_bills"."paid_at" IS NULL AND "credit_card_bills"."paid_amount" = 0) OR ("credit_card_bills"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_card_bills"."paid_amount" > 0)

tx_bill_payment_unique.name: tx_bill_payment_unique
tx_bill_payment_unique.where: domain_type = 'bill_payment' AND is_reversed = false AND billing_year IS NOT NULL

tx_materialized_unique.name: tx_materialized_unique
tx_materialized_unique.where: scheduled_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND is_reversed = false
